attempts.sql: SELECT T.Name AS Territory, COUNT(H.SalesOrderID) AS Orders, ROUND(SUM(H.SubTotal), 2) AS Sales FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader AS H INNER JOIN Sales.SalesTerritory AS T ON H.TerritoryID = T.TerritoryID WHERE H.OrderDate >= @start_date AND H.OrderDate < DATEADD(day, 1, @end_date) GROUP BY T.Name ORDER BY Sales DESC
attempts.explanation: Joined SalesOrderHeader and SalesTerritory on TerritoryID, filtered by order date within the given parameters (inclusive of end date by using less than the next day), counted the orders and summed the subtotal grouped by territory name, rounded to 2 decimal places, and sorted by sales in descending order.
